summary: The proposed patch addresses a specific issue where the assertion rewriter fails when the first expression of a file is a number, mistakenly treated as a docstring. The patch introduces a type check to ensure the docstring is a string before attempting to iterate over it.

issues.description: The patch is narrowly scoped to the failing test case and does not address potential similar issues with other non-string types.
The patch could be improved by adding a comment explaining why the type check is necessary.
